allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(settings\): strip whitespace from environment variables for Vercel compatibility

Root Cause: Vercel dashboard environment variables contained trailing newlines
\(e.g., ''claude\\n'' instead of ''claude''\), causing Pydantic Literal validation
to fail during serverless function initialization.

Solution: Added field_validator with mode=''before'' to strip whitespace from
all string environment variables before validation. This handles:
- Trailing newlines from copy/paste
- Leading/trailing spaces
- Any whitespace characters

Impact:
- Fixes 404 on /api/healthz \(API now initializes correctly\)
- Prevents future whitespace-related validation errors
- Backwards compatible \(existing clean values unaffected\)

Testing: Added test_settings_whitespace.py with coverage for:
- Trailing newlines \(APP_MODE\)
- Trailing spaces \(CLAUDE_API_KEY\)
- Leading spaces \(SEARCH_PROVIDER\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
